posts.title: RRB JE 04/2026 Recruitment — 4098 Junior Engineer Posts
posts.org: Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs), Ministry of Railways
posts.postName: Junior Engineer (JE), Depot Material Superintendent (DMS) & Chemical and Metallurgical Assistant (CMA)
posts.qualification: Diploma/Degree in relevant Engineering / Chemistry / Metallurgy disciplines
posts.desc: Railway Recruitment Boards have released CEN No. 04/2026 for 4,098 Junior Engineer, Depot Material Superintendent and Chemical & Metallurgical Assistant posts. Apply online from 14 August to 13 September 2026.
details: Pay Level: Level-6 (7th CPC) with initial pay ₹35,400/-
Age relaxation as per Government rules for reserved categories
Post-wise vacancy split: JE (4,098), DMS & CMA as per notification

sections.h2: How to Apply for RRB JE 2026
paras: The application process is fully online. Candidates must register on the official RRB application portal before the closing date.
list: Visit the official RRB website rrbapply.gov.in
Open the RRB JE CEN 04/2026 recruitment section
Complete online registration and fill the form
Submit and save a printout for reference

faqs.q: What is the total vacancy for RRB JE 2026?
faqs.a: A total of 4,098 posts have been notified under CEN 04/2026, covering Junior Engineer, DMS and CMA posts across Indian Railways zones.

faqs.q: What is the age limit for RRB JE?
faqs.a: The age limit is 18 to 33 years as of the notification date, with relaxation for reserved categories per government rules.

faqs.q: What is the RRB JE selection process?
faqs.a: Selection involves a Computer Based Test (CBT), followed by Document Verification and Medical Examination.

paras: The complete examination calendar is given below so you never miss a deadline.

faqs.q: What is the IBPS Clerk 2026 vacancy?
faqs.a: A total of 11,403 posts are notified for the Customer Service Associate post across 11 participating public sector banks. Vacancies are indicative and can change.

faqs.q: What is the IBPS Clerk age limit?
faqs.a: Candidates must be between 20 and 28 years of age as on 01-08-2026. Age relaxation applies per government norms.

faqs.q: What is the IBPS Clerk application fee?
faqs.a: The fee is ₹850 for General/OBC candidates and ₹175 for SC/ST/PwBD/ESM/DESM candidates.
